name: Pedro Parra
role: Lead, Applied AI & Commercial Operations (APAC) at Google
tagline: I build agentic AI systems for Google's commercial teams across APAC. Brazilian in Singapore. Engineer by training, strategist by trade, and a compulsive builder of over-engineered apps for family trips.
intro: Hi, I'm Pedro. I lead Applied AI & Commercial Operations for Google in APAC, where I design and ship agentic systems that replace the spreadsheets nobody loved. Before that I spent six years on the strategy side of Google's hardware business, three at LinkedIn, and two at McKinsey.

I'm an electrical engineer who took the long way round through consulting and go-to-market strategy and ended up back where I started: building things. These days that means stateful LLM orchestrators at work and, at home, a suspiciously elaborate trip planner for six people and a Portuguese-speaking dashboard or two.

I've worked out of São Paulo, Kansas City, Berkeley and, since 2016, Singapore. This site is laid out as a flight log because that's roughly how my career happened: a sequence of legs, each a little further from home, each with a story.
now: Shipping the APAC Commercial Insights Agent, a multi-tier agentic framework built on stateful LLM orchestrators that automates commercial analysis across six retail markets.
Prototyping on-device AI for enterprise partners, including a multimodal edge diagnostics tool built on Gemini Nano.
Writing evals, governance playbooks and the occasional PRD so that agents can be trusted with real numbers.
Planning a winter trip to Japan for six, with the app I built to argue about it.

legs.title: Lead, Applied AI & Commercial Operations, APAC
legs.summary: Directing the strategy, architecture and deployment of agentic AI systems and enterprise prototypes across APAC commercial operations.
highlights: Defined the roadmap for and deployed the APAC Commercial Insights Agent: a multi-tier agentic framework on stateful LLM orchestrators that automates multi-source analysis across six retail markets and cut manual data assembly by about 70%.

Built a roadmap of on-device AI prototypes for enterprise pitches, including a multimodal edge solution on Gemini Nano for Ather Energy field diagnostics, with acoustic and visual defect detection designed to cut diagnostic cycles by 40% and prevent more than $1.7M a year in operational leakage.
Set up regional AI governance, evaluation benchmarks and operational playbooks across commercial and finance teams, replacing spreadsheet analysis with auditable agent workflows.

legs.title: Product Manager, Help & Education (20% rotation)
legs.summary: Led a cross-functional squad of engineering, operations, legal and UX to reverse a funnel decline and build the next generation of merchant compliance.
highlights: Increased the merchant upgrade rate by 120% and the success rate by 53% for roughly 245,000 merchants.
Designed and launched data localization, video recording and geo-fencing pipelines that follow Reserve Bank of India guidelines, de-risking high-volume merchant acquiring.

Spearheaded an AI-first verification strategy: agents handle the objective pre-flight checks, humans handle the subjective edge cases. Directed engineering to a working prototype on Gemini Live for real-time OCR, liveness and physical store verification.

legs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, APAC Devices & Services
legs.summary: Regional commercial governance and go-to-market strategy for a multi-billion dollar hardware portfolio: Pixel, Nest and friends.
highlights: Shaped the APAC commercial strategy for more than ten product launches, led annual planning and designed new deal structures that drove double-digit growth in key markets.
Built and led the Category Business Management function as a people manager: hired, onboarded and coached a team of three and set the team's vision.
Led the region to Google's best 2022 results globally by enabling about $100M in additional revenue in Japan, where Pixel reached a record share of over 20%.

legs.title: Sales Operations & Strategy, LATAM & APAC
legs.summary: The leg that moved me from Brazil to Singapore. Multi-regional go-to-market strategy for a $250M business segment.
highlights: Project-managed sales planning for the segment: top-down financial targets, headcount, territory segmentation and quotas.
Partnered with the LATAM sales leader on initiatives that drove 40% compound annual growth and an expansion to more than 100 reps across ten countries.
Designed and rolled out an SMB field sales operation in APAC against a $200M opportunity, and saved the team 50 hours a quarter by automating business reviews with SQL.

legs.title: Management Consultant
legs.city: São Paulo, with a stint in the Netherlands
legs.summary: Advised technology, telecom and banking executives on market entry, digital channels and operational efficiency.
highlights: Assessed the digital capabilities of a pioneering digital bank in Brazil and built the growth strategy behind a roughly $100M investment plan.
Modelled the replacement of physical branches with digital channels for a major Brazilian bank, cutting branch infrastructure costs by 30%.
Supported more than five private equity diligences and uncovered about $75M in technology synergies for European payments companies. Also a pro bono consultant for Ashoka's social entrepreneurs.

legs.title: Equity Research Intern
legs.summary: Six months of maintaining financial models and compiling market data on listed companies. I learned to love a clean spreadsheet, which made it easier to replace them later.

legs.company: University of São Paulo, Escola Politécnica
legs.title: Bachelor of Electrical Engineering
legs.city: São Paulo, Kansas City and Berkeley
legs.summary: An engineering degree with a year abroad on a full scholarship from the Brazilian Ministry of Education: Computer Engineering at the University of Missouri, Kansas City, and a summer of Social Media Sciences at UC Berkeley.
highlights: Captain of the university futsal team for five years, after a season as a professional futsal player at Club Santa Barbara in 2007 and 2008.
Mentor in the Poli-USP alumni association's mentorship programme.

certifications: AI Evals for Engineers & PMs, Parlance Labs
